prompt: Create an original 180 second instrumental synthwave instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: analog arpeggiator, synth bass, electronic drums. Style: steady retro pulse with luminous melodic synth phrases. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; G minor. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A dark, atmospheric electronic track with a driving beat, featuring synth pads, arpeggiated melodies, and a strong rhythmic foundation. It builds tension and has a slightly melancholic yet energetic feel.
description.zh: 一首黑暗、大气的电子音乐，带有强劲的节拍，以合成器铺垫、琶音旋律和坚实的节奏基础为特色。它营造出紧张感，并带有一丝忧郁而充满活力的感觉。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
